Article Title: Caitlin Clark’s emotional Kobe Bryant connection resurfaces as her own Nike shoe prepares to launch
Article Text:
USA Basketball makes long awaited Caitlin Clark decision as Women’s World Cup roster finally settles Olympic debate

Caitlin Clark’s Kobe Bryant sneaker connection started in high school

Caitlin Clark wants fans to feel connected to her Nike shoe

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

Caitlin Clark’s connection to Kobe Bryant goes beyond basketball. Long before she became one of the WNBA’s biggest stars and prepared to launch her own Nike signature shoe, Clark was simply a young basketball fan who loved sneakers. Her memories of customizing Kobe shoes now carry a different meaning as she prepares to give fans a chance to experience that same personal connection through the Caitlin 1.Clark has openly embraced sneaker culture throughout her rise in basketball. Before the attention, endorsements and signature footwear, she was a teenager looking for ways to make her favorite shoes feel more personal.That included Nike iD, the customization platform now known as Nike By You. For Clark, customizing Kobe Bryant sneakers offered more than a chance to change colors or add personal touches. It allowed her to feel connected to a player she admired.“As somebody who’s been a sneakerhead her whole life and has always wanted the newest pair of shoes, even when I was in high school, I remember going on Nike iD and iDing my own Kobes,” Clark said.The memory stands out because it captures a side of Clark that existed before she became a household name.She was not wearing a signature shoe of her own. She was a fan, choosing details for shoes linked to one of basketball’s most influential stars.That makes her story particularly fitting now. Clark is preparing to step into the same world that once fascinated her from the outside.The Caitlin 1 is scheduled to become available worldwide on October 1, giving Clark an opportunity to turn her own sneaker philosophy into something fans can share.Her goal appears to be bigger than simply putting her name on a shoe. Clark remembers what it felt like to customize footwear connected to a favorite player, and she wants her supporters to experience a similar sense of ownership.“I always loved getting to do that and making it your own, but at the same time, it’s still your favourite player’s and you’re kind of sharing that with them.“So, I hope when people grab the bright blue box, I hope you feel it right when you grab the box off the shelf, that it’s pure joy and fire and passion and it’s a part of me.”That final thought explains why the Kobe connection matters. Bryant’s shoes once gave Clark a way to express her admiration while making the footwear feel like her own. Now, Clark is on the other side of that relationship.Fans will soon be able to buy a shoe carrying her identity, style and basketball journey. For Clark, that creates a full-circle moment. The young sneakerhead who once customized Kobes is now creating a signature shoe that she hopes another generation will customize, wear and remember.The Caitlin 1 therefore represents more than another athlete-branded release. It reflects how basketball culture passes from one generation to the next, with inspiration changing hands while the passion remains.
Article Summary: Caitlin clark has openly embraced sneaker culture throughout her rise in basketball. The caitlin 1 is scheduled to become available worldwide on october 1. Clark remembers what it felt like to customize footwear connected to a favorite player, and she wants her supporters to experience a similar sense of ownership.

Article Title: Brittany Mahomes' new workout photos thirst-trapped Kelly Stafford, who is in awe

A friendship built well beyond football rivalries

Kelly Stafford and Brittany Mahomes have never been shy about hyping each other up, and Friday was no exception. Brittany shared a new Adidas workout campaign on Instagram, and Kelly couldn't resist showing love from her own account. It's a small moment, but it says a lot about the genuine friendship between two of the NFL's most visible WAGs, one that's clearly built on more than just their husbands sharing a football field.Brittany posted a set of photos Friday morning showing off her Adidas workout fits as part of a brand campaign with Dick's Sporting Goods, captioning the post "kinda chic to keep it OG."Kelly reposted one of the shots to her own Instagram story and added her own spin:followed by heart-eyes and fire emojis. It's a subtle but clear cosign that Kelly clearly likes what she's seeing, and she's not afraid to say so publicly.Both women know exactly how hard this kind of physique is to build and maintain, especially postpartum. Brittany and Patrick Mahomes have three kids together, while Kelly and Matthew Stafford have four daughters. That shared experience is likely part of why these two support each other so consistently online, it's not just surface-level flattery, it's mutual respect between two moms who understand the work behind the results.This isn't a one-off. Kelly has publicly defended Brittany multiple times over the years, including backing her SI Swimsuit debut and standing up for her against online critics. The two were also both present at Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce 's wedding at Madison Square Garden earlier this summer, and while no photos were allowed inside the event, it's easy to imagine the two catching up together given their history.There's an added layer of storyline here too. Stafford's Rams and Mahomes' Chiefs faced off in both teams' preseason openers over the weekend, though neither quarterback played. The two will meet for real when the Rams and Chiefs face off on "Thursday Night Football" on December 3, giving fans a reason to watch not just the quarterbacks, but the friendship in the stands too.

Article Title: Simone Biles’ shocking influencer fallout exposed after a ‘weird’ DM left her completely stunned
Article Text:
Simone Biles (Image via Getty Images)

Simone Biles opens up about the influencer DM that went wrong

Why Simone Biles still remembers the strange exchange

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

Simone Biles has never been shy about sharing the lighter, more unexpected moments of her life with fans. But one social media interaction left the Olympic champion genuinely puzzled. The seven-time Olympic gold medalist recently recalled an awkward exchange with an unnamed influencer after she reached out for a hairstylist recommendation. What began as a simple beauty question quickly became an interaction Biles still finds strange enough to remember years later.Biles said she had followed the influencer for some time because she admired her fashion, content and, especially, her consistently polished hair. At the time, Biles was also paying close attention to her own hair after facing repeated criticism over her appearance during gymnastics competitions.Her curiosity eventually led her to send a direct message asking about the stylist behind the influencer's looks. The answer, however, was not what Biles expected."The reason why I followed her is because I loved her style, her content," Biles said. "She was super, super cute, but her hair was always laid to a T.Like, I could not tell if that was her real hair or a weave. And at the time, I was like …I would say, particular about hair."Biles explained why the question mattered to her at the time."I didn't really give a f*** that much, but, like, y'all have been bullying me for so long about what my hair looked like during competitions so I'm like, 'OK, if my hair looks like that, they're not gonna say anything.'"The response from the influencer, though, caught Biles off guard."She replies, 'Bless. My manager has it. I'll have to ask her,'" Biles said, slamming her tablet closed. "What? You don't know who does your hair when you go to your hair appointments? You don't have their contact or Instagram? Like, I get gatekeeping, but to a certain extent."Rather than seeing the request as a possible attempt to take the stylist, Biles said she simply wanted another option available when traveling. She also pointed out that she and the influencer lived in different states, making the idea of directly competing for the same hairstylist seem unlikely.Biles eventually unfollowed the influencer, but the encounter apparently stayed with her. She admitted that she continues to think about the exchange and remains unsure whether she was overreacting or whether the response was genuinely unusual."And mind you, we lived in two different states, so I think maybe she thought, like, I was gonna steal her hairstylist or something, but that's not at all what it was. I travel all the time, so if I'm ever in that area, like, 'Hey, let me get slayed real quick.'"Biles later put the entire situation to her followers, turning an uncomfortable memory into a funny social media moment."But isn't that weird? Is that weird or that's just me?" she asked. "Does that happen to y'all? I don't know. I just. To this day, I still think about it, and it cracks me up, but also, like, what? Yeah. I don't know."The gymnast has also shown that she is perfectly comfortable reaching out to celebrities herself. At a July appearance at the Faces of Fitness festival in Chicago, Biles shared another amusing social media story involving singer Avril Lavigne. After Lavigne apparently ended up with her YSL sunglasses, Biles said she sent a direct message asking, "Yo, can I get those YSLs back?"Lavigne had not responded at the time Biles shared the story. Together, the anecdotes offer a glimpse of Biles away from competition: direct, playful and willing to laugh about the odd encounters that follow life in the public eye.
Article Summary: Olympic gold medalist simone biles recently recalled an awkward dm with an influencer. Biles said she followed the influencer because she admired her fashion, content and her consistently polished hair. The response from the influencers caught biles off guard, and she unfollowed her.

America’s Sweethearts: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders is heading into another season, but the latest cast update comes with a major twist. Netflix has renewed the popular docuseries for season 4, giving fans another look at the women behind the Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders. While several familiar faces are expected to return, some beloved dancers have already closed this chapter, creating a very different lineup for the next season.Season 4 will follow the Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders through the 2026 NFL season, with the focus shifting toward dancers who earned their places on the squad after the latest audition and training process.Several recognizable names are expected to remain part of the story. Charly Barby enters the 2026 season as a second group leader, while her close friend Kelly Villares also made the team again. Anna Kate Sundvold has gone from rookie to group leader, showing just how quickly the DCC journey can change.Camille Sturdivant is another returning group leader, while Faith Ward moves into her veteran year. Jenna Waller also has another opportunity after her comeback story became one of the memorable parts of season 3.Emily Awbrey has an especially interesting path into the new season. After being eliminated during season 3, the former cruise ship dancer returned to compete again and successfully made the 2026 squad.Savanna Dastrup also turned disappointment into another chance. After being cut in season 3, she came back stronger and earned her place on the team for 2026. Her comeback is likely to become one of the more compelling storylines when the new episodes arrive.Behind the dancers, Kelli Finglass and Judy Trammell are also set to continue their roles. Article Title: "She didn't feel like I was doing my part": Tom Brady revealed the heartbreaking moment Gisele Bündchen told him she was no longer happy in their marriage
Article Text:
Tom Brady and Gisele Bündchen (Getty Images)

Why Gisele Bündchen felt alone in the marriage

What Tom Brady did to save his marriage

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

Some confessions don't come from a press conference podium. They come from a radio studio, when a guy famous for keeping his personal life locked away finally decides to unlock it. That's exactly what happened when Tom Brady sat down with Howard Stern in 2020 and admitted his marriage to Gisele Bündchen had quietly started cracking under the weight of his football career.The problem wasn't a single fight or one bad season. It built up over years. Brady spent every fall and winter buried in football, and the moment the season wrapped, he didn't slow down. He jumped straight into training and business ventures, leaving Bündchen to manage the house, the kids, and everything in between, largely on her own.Brady laid it out plainly to Stern. "A couple of years ago, she didn't feel like I was doing my part for the family," he said. "She felt like I would play football all season and she would take care of the house, and then all of a sudden when the season would end, I'd be like, 'Great, let me get into all of my other business activities. Let me get into my football training,' and she's sitting there going, 'Well, when are you going to do things for the house? When are you going to take the kids to school and do that?'"It wasn't just about chores or scheduling. Bündchen was asking for something bigger, and Brady knew it."And that was a big part of our marriage," he continued. "I had to, like, check myself. Because she's like, 'I have goals and dreams too. It's not just doing this and this. You better start taking care of things at the house.'"Hearing one of the most decorated athletes in sports history admit he needed to "check himself" said more about his marriage than any highlight reel ever could.Talk is easy. Brady backed his words with action. He stepped away from the Patriots' voluntary offseason program, a decision most players in his position would never make, so he could actually be present at home. The couple also started counseling together, working through frustration that had clearly been sitting under the surface for a while.One detail from that chapter has stuck with Brady long after the arguments faded. Bündchen wrote him a letter putting her feelings into words, and he still keeps it close. "She actually wrote me a letter, and it was a very thought-out letter that she wrote to me and I still have it and I keep it in a drawer and I read it," he shared."It's a very heartfelt letter for her to say this is where I'm at in our marriage, and it's a good reminder for me that things are going to change and evolve over time. What happened and what worked for us 10 years ago won't work for us forever, because we are growing in different ways."That last line is the real takeaway. Marriages don't run on autopilot, even for people who seem to have everything figured out. Brady's honesty about that struggle turned a private low point into a reminder that even a Super Bowl winner has to keep showing up, at home and not just on the field.
Article Summary: Tom brady and gisele bündchen have been married for 10 years. The new england patriots quarterback opened up about his marriage to howard stern. He said his marriage started cracking under the weight of his football career. The couple also started counseling together, working through frustration.

Article Title: Chiefs players reportedly turn on Travis Kelce in private group chats as controversial decisions spark locker-room drama
Article Text:
​Travis Kelce (Getty Images)

Travis Kelce wedding invitations trigger Chiefs player reactions

Chiefs group chats reveal a different side of wedding drama

Travis Kelce’s wedding to Taylor Swift may have brought together two of the biggest names in sports and entertainment, but the guest list is now drawing attention for a very different reason. Reports of Chiefs players discussing the invitations in private group chats have added an unexpected layer of locker-room intrigue, with Harrison Butker’s absence reportedly becoming one of the main talking points ahead of training camp.The wedding reportedly drew more than 1,000 guests, including family members, close friends and several prominent Kansas City Chiefs figures. Patrick and Brittany Mahomes, Andy Reid, Chris Jones and Isiah Pacheco were among the football names reported to have attended.But not everyone connected to the Chiefs received the same treatment. According to the report cited by The Red Zone, some players discussed the guest list and Butker’s absence in private conversations.One unnamed Chiefs player reportedly explained that the situation was less hostile than some social media reactions suggested, while acknowledging that teammates had plenty to say behind the scenes."It’s really their wedding, and I understand why they wouldn’t have invited [Butker]. But there’s some difference of opinion [between players]. Lots of texts are going around the team, and some people who are close to Harrison feel like he was snubbed.""The general idea was that there was a blanket invite for the team, but [every other player] received something individually. If Harrison had really wanted to come, he probably could have. But they’re not close, so… he wasn’t going to go, even if he had been invited."The same player also described a locker room that enjoys teasing and gossip as much as any other workplace."There’s now a lot of gossip going on. Training camp [for the new NFL season] starts in three weeks, and it’s going to be a whole thing. A lot of guys want it to be drama [between Butker and Kelce]. They just like that s**t… a couple of the guys are being messy and texting Harrison to see what he thinks. We’re like a high school team sometimes."The report also offered a glimpse into how Chiefs players communicate away from the field. Rather than one massive team conversation, players reportedly belong to smaller groups based on friendships, positions and personal relationships.A second unnamed Chiefs player said:‘It’s not like all of us are in the same [group chat]. The team is too big. So there are groups that might just be like defense [players], or a certain group of guys. There are some with me in, some without me. I am in about seven chains of players, some are professional… some are just used for talking s**t.‘I have chains that have Travis on them, and chains that don’t. You always have to check to make sure you’re sending to the right chain. There have been times where you’ll talk s**t about someone and then realize they are in the group, and have to laugh it off.‘I think most of the texts about the wedding are probably being sent in the groups without Travis. I have one that has about eight of us, and, before the wedding, it was like “Who’s going?” And everyone was saying where they were staying, or why they weren’t going.‘I think maybe half the team went, probably less. A lot of people RSVP’d no, not because of anything bad, but because of a conflict. I didn’t go because I didn’t want to spend the 4th in New York and couldn’t bring my kids.‘Some people asked, “Do we have to send them a gift?’, because they have more money than us, which was funny. People were coming up with funny things to send. I thought it would be funny to send him something that was monogrammed “Mr and Mrs Swift”. That type of thing. We sent each other memes and pictures.’The first player later offered another explanation for why the situation should not be viewed as a serious fracture inside the Chiefs.‘Can’t say too much because Travis is my friend… Yeah, there are a few group texts. I’m on one with Harrison [Butker]. Someone sent a news story about him not being invited, and the group was like “WTF?” But he didn’t reply.‘I don’t think anyone on the team wishes [Kelce] anything but good things. Everyone likes him. He’s a good teammate and a good friend. There’s locker room s**t, but it’s nothing disrespectful.‘Most of [our group] texts were just logistics about how people were getting from their hotels to the wedding, or what everyone was going to wear. The women [players’ wives and girlfriends] have other text groups. Taylor is officially a football wife now, and she’ll be invited to their wine nights and stuff, but she won’t go. I’m sure of that. But if you want trash talk, you have to see their group texts. My girlfriend won’t even let me look at her phone to see it. ’For now, the reported wedding chatter appears to be more about teasing, curiosity and differing opinions than a genuine Chiefs feud. Still, with training camp approaching, even small personal stories can attract outsized attention when they involve Kelce, Swift and one of the NFL’s most closely followed locker rooms.

Article Title: How Aaron Rodgers' decision not to face his old Jets team in preseason speaks volumes about his mindset
Article Text:
Aaron Rodgers (Getty Images)

Why did Aaron Rodgers not play against the Jets in preseason 2026?

What does Aaron Rodgers sitting out mean for his final season with the Steelers?

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

Aaron Rodgers sat out Pittsburgh's preseason game against the New York Jets on Friday night, and the Jets made the absence count. The Steelers' offense was shut out in an ugly loss, with the Jets winning 17-0 at Acrisure Stadium. Head coach Mike McCarthy had chosen to rest both veteran quarterbacks, starting Will Howard and giving Drew Allar the second half -- a decision that, given the opponent, carries more than just roster implications. This game was arguably the last time these two teams could meet before Rodgers hangs up his cleats, given no regular-season matchup is scheduled between Pittsburgh and New York this year.The official answer is clean enough. McCarthy wanted to maximize opportunities for his two young quarterbacks. “They’re young,” McCarthy said Wednesday in explaining his decision to play [Will] Howard and [Drew] Allar over the veterans via ESPN’s Brooke Pryor. “Will didn’t get to play last year. … I have some veterans I feel really good about, obviously with Aaron and Mason. I saw what I needed to see from Mason last week. I’ve talked highly about Mason really since the spring. So I really want to max out the opportunities with both Will and Drew.We’ve got two games here, and I want to see those guys play as much as possible, and we’ll continue as we have all camp.”On the field, neither young quarterback delivered. Howard threw two interceptions in the first half and his night ended with the Steelers trailing 7-0. Allar took over for the entire second half but couldn't put points on the board either, with the Jets extending their lead to 17-0 before the final whistle. Cam Johnston's punting was, as one outlet noted, the highlight of the evening -- which says everything about how the offense performed.The scoreline stings, but the context is what makes it interesting. The first big move Aaron Glenn made as Jets head coach was throwing Rodgers out the door. The four-time NFL MVP admitted he felt "disrespected" by that final meeting with Glenn. Rodgers described being blindsided by what he expected to be a real conversation: "That was an interesting two years, to say the least, but I figured that when I flew across the country on my own dime, that there was going to be a conversation. And the confusing thing to me and the strange thing was when I went out there I meet with the coach… we start talking, he runs out of the room."After two forgettable years in New York, Rodgers had an up-and-down first campaign in Pittsburgh, throwing for 3,322 yards with 24 touchdowns and seven interceptions. He came back for one more run specifically because McCarthy, his longtime Green Bay coach, was hired to lead the Steelers. "Yes. This is it," Rodgers told reporters when asked if 2026 would be his final NFL season. There is, by his own admission, zero ambiguity about what this season represents.So what does it mean that he sat out the one preseason game that doubled as a potential final chapter with the Jets? Practically, nothing -- McCarthy made the call, and Rodgers has always treated preseason as time to protect his body. Entering his 22nd season, Rodgers has long been anti-preseason.But symbolically, it fits the broader narrative of a quarterback who has moved past New York entirely. He did not need a staged reunion, a dramatic sideline glance at Aaron Glenn, or a two-minute cameo for closure. The 2026 season is a reunion with McCarthy, who spent 13 years coaching Rodgers in Green Bay before his departure for two fruitless years in New York. That story arc matters far more to Rodgers than anything the Jets could offer now.The Jets won Friday night. Rodgers wasn't watching from the sideline. That, in itself, says plenty.
Article Summary: Aaron rodgers sat out pittsburgh's preseason game against the new york jets. The steelers' offense was shut out in an ugly loss, with the jets winning 17-0 at acrisure stadium. This game was arguably the last time these two teams could meet before rodgers hangs up his cleats.

Mumbai: Prabath Jayasuriya is a rarity in modern-day cricket, especially in the subcontinent, where if you are aged 30 and above, you are not favoured to play international cricket. He waited in the shadows of Sri Lanka’s rich spin tradition. When his chance finally arrived in July 2022, the left-arm spinner grabbed it spectacularly, claiming 12 wickets on Test debut against Australia in Galle.Since then, Jayasuriya has carried Sri Lanka’s spin legacy with distinction, taking 132 wickets in 24 Tests. Ahead of the second Test against India at the SSC, the 34-year-old spoke to TOI about his journey, Sri Lanka’s chances of levelling the series, and why he believes India’s young left-arm spinner Manav Suthar can become one of the world’s best. Excerpts...I had waited a long time for that opportunity. I made my debut after turning 30 and it was a dream start. It remains my favourite match in cricket. After that performance, I realised there was a bigger responsibility because I was representing Sri Lanka. Expectations increased and sometimes the team looks to you for something extra.That brings extra pressure.We knew the pitch would be good for batting early on. KL Rahul and Devdutt Padikkal used those conditions very well and built the foundation for India. We improved in the second innings but by then the game had gone away from us. India’s batters handled spin well.India batted really well. As a bowling unit, we need to have clearer plans and also execute them better. If we can do that consistently, I believe we can get a better result in the second Test.Joe Root, Kane Williamson and Steve Smith.As players, we have to believe. We have some challenging series coming up, including away tours of Pakistan and New Zealand and a home series against South Africa. The important thing is to stay focused on our processes.Both Kusal Mendis and Dinesh Chandimal are out...It’s a big loss. Both are experienced players and important members of the team. At the same time, it opens the door for younger players to step in and prove themselves.He has the potential to become one of the best bowlers in the world. He needs to stay committed to the process, work hard and make sacrifices. If he remains consistent, I believe he can achieve great things.The pitch generally starts turning after the first couple of days. Consistency is the key there. If you keep bowling the right line and length, you can be successful. That’s exactly what Manav did in the first Test.The SSC is my home ground because I play my domestic cricket there. I understand the conditions well. The key is to adapt quickly and keep things simple.Every Test batter is a challenge. Devdutt Padikkal played extremely well in Galle and handled both spin and pace impressively. As the lead spinner in the team, I have a big responsibility. Against strong teams, we need detailed plans and extra effort.
Article Summary: Prabath jayasuriya took 12 wickets on test debut against australia in galle. The 34-year-old has carried sri lanka’s spin legacy with distinction, taking 132 wickets in 24 tests. The left-arm spinner believes manav suthar can become one of the world's best. Against strong teams, we need detailed plans and extra effort.

Article Title: Is Geno Smith already proving Aaron Glenn right about the Jets’ biggest gamble?
Article Text:
Geno Smith completed all seven of his passes and led the New York Jets to a touchdown on his only drive against the Pittsburgh Steelers.(Image via Getty)

What did Geno Smith show Aaron Glenn in his first Jets game in nine years?

What still needs work after Geno Smith's perfect opening drive for the Jets?

Geno Smith waited more than nine years to play another game in a New York Jets uniform. His return lasted one drive. He did not waste it.Smith completed all seven of his passes for 65 yards and a touchdown Friday as New York beat the Pittsburgh Steelers 17-0. Head coach Aaron Glenn saw enough from the 35-year-old quarterback to say the Jets got what they wanted from their new starter.Smith took the opening possession and moved the Jets 69 yards in 10 plays. The drive lasted nearly six minutes and ended with his 13-yard touchdown pass to tight end Jelani Woods.According to Jets.com contributor Jack Bell, Glenn praised Smith's command of the offense after the game.“Very, very efficient, he looked very comfortable,” Glenn said. “Exactly what we were looking for. But again, we still have some things we got to work on because our run game wasn't where it needs to be.”The numbers backed up the first part of Glenn's assessment. Smith went 7-for-7 and finished with a 144.9 passer rating. He completed passes to several targets and converted two third downs through the air. One went to tight end Mason Taylor for 10 yards. Another found Garrett Wilson for 10 yards and moved New York to Pittsburgh's 13-yard line.Smith threw the touchdown on the next play. His final stat line came from a tiny preseason sample, and Pittsburgh rested several starters. Still, Smith did what New York needed him to do. He moved the offense, handled pressure and finished the possession with seven points.That mattered after Smith missed the Jets' preseason opener because of a sore ankle. New York had indicated the injury was not considered serious, but Friday offered the first game look at its projected Week 1 starter.It also came with history attached.The Jets selected Smith in the second round of the 2013 NFL Draft. His previous start for New York came on Oct. 23, 2016, before a torn ACL ended his season. The franchise reacquired him from the Las Vegas Raiders in March 2026.Smith returned after throwing for 3,025 yards, 19 touchdowns and 17 interceptions in 15 games for Las Vegas last season.His first drive back in green looked considerably cleaner.Glenn's praise came with an immediate qualifier. He specifically pointed to New York's running game. The Jets had the result they wanted from Smith, but one efficient possession does not answer every offensive question before the regular season.Smith also refused to treat seven completions on seven attempts as a finished product.“There's always room for improvement, but we're always going to strive for perfection,” Smith said, according to Bell. “I don't really get too high or too low on anything. I think it's about the process, and I'm really focused on the process.”That approach fits where the Jets are right now.Smith is expected to start Week 1 against the Tennessee Titans, so New York did not need him playing deep into a preseason game. It needed evidence that he could operate the offense comfortably after the ankle issue.Friday provided exactly that. SNY's Lucas Hutcherson also noted Smith's work under pressure during the opening series. He stood in to complete throws and kept the drive moving on third down before finding Woods for the touchdown.The bigger test comes when the games count and defenses stop treating the night like an August evaluation.For now, Glenn has one drive of evidence. Smith completed every official pass he attempted, produced a touchdown and walked off the field healthy.The Jets close their preseason against the New York Giants on Friday, Aug. 28. After that, the evaluation changes.Smith's second stint in New York has officially reached the field. His first seven passes gave Glenn very little to complain about.
Article Summary: Geno smith completed all seven of his passes and led the jets to a touchdown on his only drive against the pittsburgh steelers. Head coach aaron glenn praised smith's command of the offense after the game. Smith is expected to start week 1 against the tennessee titans, so new york did not need him playing deep into a preseason game.

Article Title: Super Bowl LXI lands on Valentine’s Day for the first time in history creating an unusual football-versus-romance showdown

Super Bowl LXI and Valentine’s Day create a unique clash

Super Bowl 2027 brings another major change for NFL fans

Super Bowl LXI is about to create a very unusual sporting dilemma. The NFL ’s championship game is scheduled for February 14, 2027, putting it on Valentine’s Day for the first time in Super Bowl history. With romance and football competing for the same Sunday, fans have already begun joking about dinner reservations, watch parties and the ultimate relationship compromise.The date alone is enough to make the 2027 Super Bowl stand out. The game will take place at SoFi Stadium in Inglewood, California, on February 14, meaning couples will have to decide how they want to spend one of the biggest nights on the American sporting calendar.For football fans, the answer may seem obvious. For couples with different priorities, however, the evening could require some negotiation.Social media has already embraced the idea. One Reddit commenter joked about the pressure on restaurants, writing:"The Valentine's Day brunch reservations are going to be harder to get than a Super Bowl ticket."Another post took the joke even further, imagining the holiday as a test of romantic loyalty:"Super Bowl on Valentine's? Peak relationship apocalypse incoming—guys choosing touchdowns over touchy-feely dates. Ladies, demand a halftime proposal or it's single season next year."The humor works because the conflict is so easy to imagine. A romantic dinner could overlap with pregame coverage. A reservation might clash with kickoff.And anyone hosting a Super Bowl party could suddenly find themselves planning around Valentine's Day expectations.There is also a convenient escape route. The game falls on Presidents' Day weekend, giving many people the chance to turn the occasion into a longer celebration. Couples could celebrate Valentine's Day on Saturday, watch the Super Bowl on Sunday and use Monday to recover from the late night.The unusual date is not the only reason Super Bowl LXI will be significant. ESPN will broadcast the championship game for the first time in network history, with ABC also carrying the event. ESPN has already outlined extensive programming and storytelling designed to build anticipation well before the game itself.The timing also feeds into a broader conversation about the Super Bowl calendar. The NFL has long faced calls to make the Monday after the championship game a national holiday, particularly because fans already tend to treat Presidents' Day weekend as a natural extension of Super Bowl celebrations.Commissioner Roger Goodell has previously discussed how changes to the NFL schedule could eventually push the Super Bowl toward Presidents' Day weekend. In comments cited in the original report, he said:"I think if you went to 18 weeks regular season that would probably occur," Goodell said at the time. "It is possible somewhere in the calendar. Could happen before that just because of the calendar, the way it lays out.But I think 18 weeks would get you to that point, and I think it would be a really great move."For now, February 14, 2027 remains a one-of-a-kind collision between football and romance. The NFL has confirmed the date, and fans have plenty of time to decide whether Super Bowl Sunday will be a date-night disaster, a couples' tradition or simply the perfect excuse to order wings and watch football together.
Article Summary: Super bowl 2027 brings another major change for nfl fans. With romance and football competing for the same sunday, fans have already begun joking about dinner reservations. The game will take place at sofi stadium in inglewood, california, on february 14, 2027.

Brock Lesnar and Ric Flair are two of the biggest names in professional wrestling. But they have had very different experiences in terms of money. Lesnar was a crossover combat-sports star after excelling in amateur wrestling, WWE and the UFC, while Flair made his name over more than four decades in WCW and WWE. Their current net-worth estimates vary significantly across sources and should be treated cautiously because personal assets, debts, taxes, expenses and private income are not fully disclosed.But there is a big gap, and public net-worth numbers are best seen as estimates, not audited financial statements. Lesnar’s contracts in the modern era, UFC purses and limited-appearance model allowed him to make individual paydays that were much larger than what was generally available to wrestlers during Flair’s peak years. Meanwhile, Flair continues to earn from his name, appearances, licensing and wrestling-related projects, despite the financial difficulties that have beset his wealth over the years.Brock Lesnar seems to be in a better financial state at the moment. Celebrity Net Worth estimates his net worth at $10 million, whereas NDTV reported an estimate of $17 million in June 2026. Other outlets have published higher numbers, a testament to the uncertainties that come with calculating celebrity net worth.Ric Flair is worth much less. His net worth has been estimated to be $500,000 by Celebrity Net Worth, but other estimates online have put the figure at a much higher number. The variation reflects the absence of publicly verified personal financial records, and the challenge of calculating assets, liabilities, royalties and ongoing income for a longtime entertainer.Lesnar’s wealth is intrinsically tied to his ability to command top dollar. He was an instant star in WWE after debuting in 2002, but he later moved away from the wrestling world to try his hand at the NFL and mixed martial arts before returning to WWE as an established crossover star.Lesnar’s career in WWE has been as much about scarcity as it has been about star power. He was often employed on a limited schedule around major storylines and premium live events for most of his later career instead of working weekly.Lesnar’s UFC career distinguished his money story from most WWE stars. After leaving professional wrestling, he came into MMA and immediately became a big draw. Beating Randy Couture for the heavyweight championship at UFC 91 made him a legit heavyweight champion and gave him a serious bump in commercial appeal.Lesnar has also earned money from endorsements and appearances. Jimmy John’s and other commercial deals are among his previous endorsement deals, and his celebrity status has helped his value outside the ring.He has also kept his lifestyle very private. Recent reports have pointed out that he prefers a rural lifestyle and owning vast amounts of land, rather than the high-profile celebrity lifestyle that many sports stars enjoy.Ric Flair’s financial story started in an era when the economics of professional wrestling were very different. The Nature Boy became one of the defining stars of the National Wrestling Alliance, World Championship Wrestling and WWE, headlining big events and winning championships through a career that spanned several decades.Flair made a ton of money in his time with WCW. One published estimate puts his WCW earnings from 1996-2000 at about $1.95 million. But the size of his earnings did not translate directly into lasting wealth because of taxes, legal obligations, medical expenses and other financial pressures.He also made a lot of money from his WWE career. Flair was a wrestler, manager and personality and stayed a close associate of the company for years. In 2005, during a divorce hearing, it was revealed that his annual WWE salary was reportedly around $500,000, showing how much he could make from wrestling even later in his career.Of the two stars, Flair's financial history is the starkest contrast. Celebrity Net Worth states that in 2000, the IRS filed a lien of more than $870,000 against him, and his further tax problems damaged his finances. The same source reports that in 2019 there was a major medical emergency that resulted in a medical bill of approximately $1.8 million.These pressures help explain why lifetime earnings and current net worth can look so dramatically different. Making millions in a career doesn’t always translate to keeping millions after taxes, debts, medical expenses and other costs.Lesnar’s future financial prospects will probably continue to be linked to his standing as a top-tier combat sports attraction. As his active wrestling career is changing, his name still has value for special appearances, merchandise, licensing and media projects.Flair’s earning model is a unique one. At 77, his money-making opportunities are increasingly linked to his legacy rather than regular ring competition. He still turns up at wrestling events, signs autographs and does other promotional stuff.Lesnar has a path to victory in the modern economics of sports and one of the rare WWE-to-UFC crossover careers. Flair’s financial legacy isn’t so much the wealth he has today, but the incredible value he brought to pro wrestling in terms of sales. Their careers demonstrate two different paths a wrestling superstar can take to earn money: Lesnar with premium modern contracts and crossover sports earnings, and Flair with longevity, character, championships and lasting brand recognition.
Article Summary: Brock lesnar and ric flair are two of the biggest names in professional wrestling. But they have had very different experiences in terms of money. Lesnar’s wealth is intrinsically tied to his ability to command top dollar. Flair continues to earn from his name, appearances, licensing and wrestling-related projects.
